inputs.text: Micheál Martin was out in Limerick this past week pushing the line that housing tenancies have increased even as eviction notices and homelessness keep rising after the government forced those new rules on March 1 making landlords give six-year leases. Yet the numbers of people in emergency accommodation are climbing again nationally. This is all coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions twisting the facts to hide their agenda. They're spreading this false narrative of progress to distract from how the policies are deliberately worsening the crisis for ordinary people while protecting the insiders who benefit.

output.main_topic: Housing rules, rising evictions and homelessness, and claims of progress and manipulation
